payload.core_mechanism_summary: Winner gets max possible jokers (up to hand size), remainder distributed evenly among others to minimize the second max. Uses integer division to compute the minimum possible maximum jokers among opponents.
payload.rationale: The solution directly implements the greedy exchange argument: giving the winner as many jokers as possible and then spreading the rest as evenly as possible among others maximizes the difference between winner's jokers and the maximum of others.
